changes: Screen-only switching now animates the actual live LCD and WebGL canvas instead of a copied overlay, so gameplay never freezes and no duplicate screen can snap into place.
The destination scale, duck offset, pixel geometry, bezel, and pause indicator settle into one FLIP animation; the console shell is isolated during zoom-in instead of moving behind the display.
WebGL output resolution follows the LCD throughout both zoom directions, and manual wheel, slider, and reset scaling are locked during LCD and cartridge insertion animations.
